name: Phrase filters
description: Block or replace your own phrases in their configured order. Runs locally on input and output, with no detection model. Literal matching is case-insensitive; it is not semantic content safety.

parameters.name: phrase_entries
parameters.label: Phrases and actions
parameters.description: Entries run in order within this Policy. Replacement text continues to the next entry; a block ends execution.

rules.name: Configured phrase sequence
rules.description: Execute the reviewed phrase entries. Each entry specifies block or replacement; a Rule action override applies to the entire sequence.

test_cases.name: Configured phrase acceptance
test_cases.description: Expanded into one acceptance case per configured phrase by Controller.
